facts.fact: On 2026-08-06 the Council of Ministers discussed the digital transformation ministry's draft Data and Artificial Intelligence Law and directed that it be studied further before approval by the interim parliament, a joint sitting of the Sovereignty and Ministers councils.

Provisional Decree 7 of 2026 amends six laws, including adding electronic publication to the criminal act's false-news article; it is not an AI, cybersecurity, data protection or e-commerce law.
